cat > /etc/sudoers << 'EOF'
# This file MUST be edited with the 'visudo' command as root.
#
# If you prefer to separate your sudoers rules into
# per-user files, one per user, then the sudoers.d
# directory is read as well.

## Allow root to run any commands anywhere
root    ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL

## Allow members of group sudo to execute any command
%sudo   ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL

# See sudoers(5) for more information on "@include" directives:
@includedir /etc/sudoers.d
EOF
chmod 440 /etc/sudoers
visudo -c

answer: The /etc/sudoers file had been truncated/emptied (1 byte), causing "root is not in the sudoers file" error.
